benchmark.rule: Manual behavior handbook and source-grounded manual semantic outputs are the immutable minimum evidence-completeness benchmark. Machine methods may differ; retrievable source-supported evidence completeness may not.

requirements.requirement: Every actual source-supported row from first observed through last observed is retained; no session/filter cutoff may discard it.
Every physically present source column/value remains retrievable even when Formula Research does not understand/use it.
evidence: CACHE_SCHEMA V3 source_header + source_field_values + packet fingerprint

requirements.requirement: Exact source provenance and reverse trace to source/ticker/date/time/source row are preserved.

Actual lifecycle timing: precursor, first observed, event start, first detectable, change point, known-at, confirm/non-confirm, extreme, weakening, fail, recovery, transformation/rebase, invalidation, event end, last observed, follow-through.
requirements.gap: Timing slots exist, but current V3.2 derives them only for the limited V3.0 journey families; precursor is often unpopulated and first-detectable/change-point can collapse to event start.
Raw evidence becomes retrievable, but deterministic semantic representation is not yet complete for all handbook dimensions.

requirements.requirement: Repeated test, breakout/breakdown, rejection, absorption-like response, reclaim, shakeout, extension/exhaustion, stall and failure/recovery paths are representable without forced labels.
requirements.gap: Current named machine journeys cover only RECOVERY, PULLBACK, OPEN_BREAK_RECLAIM, BUY_NONRESPONSE_WINDOW and SELL_RESILIENCE_WINDOW; unnamed state transitions are preserved but not yet sufficient as explicit semantic retrieval for all benchmark concepts.

requirements.requirement: Multi-layer evidence uses richest physically available/proven causal lanes; missing/unproven remains explicit and is not zero.
requirements.gap: OHLCV/value/NBSS/HAKA/HAKI and all raw fields become retrievable, but generic semantic availability/interpretation for additional provider lanes is not yet materialized in V3.2.

requirements.requirement: Nonregular phases including preopen/preclose/closing/postclose/special mechanisms remain evidence and terminal carry uses true source-supported terminal state.
OPEN/LEFT/RIGHT censored and unresolved journeys preserve continuation state across technical/date boundaries.
requirements.gap: Right-censored V3.x journey carry exists, but coverage is limited by the current journey vocabulary; cross-date semantic reconciliation of all manual journey types is not proven.

requirements.requirement: No forced event: flat/weak/down/no-event/contradiction/near-twin/rare/unnamed evidence remains first-class.
requirements.gap: No-forced-event and unnamed state transitions are preserved, but explicit contradiction/near-twin relationships are not produced by V3.2.

requirements.requirement: Same-date cross-ticker market-day reconciliation for full eligible universe before date close.
requirements.gap: V3.2 is ticker-day enrichment; no full market-day semantic reconciliation output.

requirements.requirement: Cross-date journey reconciliation and cross-month atlas preserve transformations until observed resolution/source boundary.
requirements.gap: Terminal carry exists, but full semantic reconciliation/atlas is outside current V3.2 implementation.

requirements.requirement: Machine 1 semantic reader remains independent; Formula Research/V3.2 cannot substitute for Machine 1 behavior PASS.
Manual behavior handbook is immutable benchmark and must never be weakened/edited to fit machine output.
Machine 1 and Machine 2 may use different mechanisms but governed comparison requires equal complete canonical actual-source evidence scope.
requirements.gap: Machine 2 packets prove all_source_columns_retained; V3.2 source-field retention was just added and still needs full-corpus proof plus benchmark reconciliation.
